title: Failed saves are visible and retryable
acceptance: A post whose fetch or extraction failed is visibly distinguishable in the library, not silently present and empty
The reason is stated in plain language — paywall, unreachable, no readable content
Retry is one tap and re-runs the real pipeline
A failed save still keeps its URL and its original HTML if any was fetched
notes: ArchiveService already marks posts .failed for paywalls and JS-only pages. If that state is invisible the owner believes something was saved when it was not — the worst possible bug for an app whose primary action is saving. Pairs with T-0027's finding that saves were being truncated silently.

history.detail: was Cairn/Views/** plus Cairn/Services/**, which collided with the three in flight; narrowed to the four files a failed-save affordance needs
